title: gcTMB: Fitting Growth Curves Using the Template Model Builder
text: Growth models: logistic (Richards), Gompertz, Hill, Weibull, normal gamma curves, asymmetry parameter, straight line comparison; optionally truncated threshold time response zero (e.g. emergence, first pods). Interpretable parameters: asymptote (maximum growth rate, b1type = "rate"), time maximum growth rate half asymptote, scale, slope shape, threshold asymmetry; identity, log, logit inverse link, can fixed. Distributions: gaussian, lognormal, poisson, binomial, beta-binomial, beta, negative binomial (nbinom1, nbinom2). Fixed random effects: formulas parameter, e.g. fform = b1 + b2 ~ treatment rform = b1 + b2 ~ 1 | plant, nlme::nlme; random effects correlated across parameters, several terms, nested crossed grouping factors random slopes, integrated Laplace approximation. Autocorrelation: AR(1) continuous-time AR(1) residuals within individuals, correlation = corCAR1(form = ~ day | plant), correlation structures nlme. Inference: profile likelihood, Wald parametric bootstrap confidence intervals; likelihood ratio tests chi-square, F parametric bootstrap p-values; information criteria; pairwise comparisons curves simultaneous confidence intervals; small-sample t F inference gaussian models without random effects. Derived quantities: times reach percentage asymptote given response (timeto()), maximum growth rate, timing fraction asymptote reached (maxrate()), standard errors confidence intervals. Prediction simulation: predictions curves parameters confidence prediction intervals, validation plots, simulation fitted model new times new individuals, e.g. simulation studies.

text: main function gcTMB(). models form f(t) = b1 F(z(t)), function F increasing 0 1 transformed time z(t): b1 asymptote approached late times, slope linear model, asymptote truncated. Hill, Weibull gamma curves positive times. links parameters can chosen, e.g. link = c(b1 = "log", b3 = "inverse"), identity (default), log, logit (b1) inverse (b3 logistic Gompertz models, rate 1/b3) links. default, curve truncated threshold time b4, (F(z(t)) - F(z(b4)))/(1 - F(z(b4))), response zero b4. b4 fixed 0, curve starts zero t = 0, unless estimated fix = c(b4 = FALSE); truncated = FALSE gives curves without truncation. model asymmetry parameter b5 > 0, fixed 1 (curves ) unless estimated fix = c(b5 = FALSE): logistic model becomes Richards curve b1 / (1 + b5 exp(-(t - b2)/b3))^(1/b5), Hill model b1 / (1 + (b2/t)b3)b5, Weibull, normal gamma models power b5 F, Gompertz model b1 (1 - (1 - exp(-exp(-(t - b2)/b3)))^b5), power survival function. b1type = "rate", b1 maximum growth rate curve instead asymptote, covariates random effects b1 act maximum growth rate.
